# Review tab in the right panel with a sticky decision bar (shared review.js)

## What to build

The human review round (`humanReview: true`) currently renders differently on the two pages:

- **Run page** (`src/web/page.html`): a rich UI that currently sits in a left overlay card inside `#main`. It has:
  - a `#review` banner with the decision buttons (`renderReview`)
  - a `#reviewdiff` section with the final diff, single-line, file and general comments, the "needs live check" checkbox
  - previous-round cards (fixer note, reviewer verdict, live check, Resolve, and Reopen with a follow-up)
- **Suite page** (`src/suite/page.html`): a minimal UI (`buildReview`):
  - a file list
  - open findings
  - a plain comment list with Resolve/Reopen
  - one textarea with a file `<select>`
  - the decision bar

This slice moves review into the **right panel** as a **Review** tab on both pages, built from one shared module, `src/web/assets/review.js`. The suite page gets the run page's richer UI.

- When the run (or suite) is waiting for review, the panel opens on the **Review** tab automatically, at ≥ 60% of the viewport width (capped at 85%), unless the user has already resized it this session.
- The tab contains:
  - a header (`Waiting for your review — round H`) and the open blocking findings, if any
  - the general comment form
  - the final diff of the round, through `mountDiffView` (file tree, unified/split, highlighting, expand context) with `onLine` for single-line comments
  - "Comment on file" buttons
  - saved comments placed after `[data-new-line=N]`
  - the previous-round cards
- The **decision bar** is sticky at the bottom of the panel:
  - **Request changes (n open)**: disabled until there is an open comment
  - **Apply**: becomes **Apply anyway** with a confirm when blockers are open, and sends `force`
  - **Drop**: with a confirm
- Clicking a graph node while review is open adds the node's tabs (Overview · Changes · Logs) next to Review, without losing review state. The left overlay card and the old `#review` / `#reviewdiff` sections are removed.
- **No behaviour change**: same endpoints, same request bodies (`{file?, line?, snippet?, body, liveCheck}`), same flow.

The previous slices delivered:

- `src/web/assets/panel.js` `createPanel(mainEl, {storageKey, tabs})`, with `open`, `setTab`, `tab(name)` and the width API
- `src/web/assets/diffview.js` `mountDiffView(container, {files, loadDiff, onLine, mode})`, which renders rows with `data-file`, `data-kind`, `data-old-line`, `data-new-line` and `data-hunk`
- `src/web/assets/shell.js`, and the left review overlay card in both pages

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/web/page.html`, review code (search for these names):
  - decisions: `postReview`, `hasOpenComments`, `syncRequestChanges`, `renderReview`
  - loading: the `rv` state, `loadReview`, `syncReviewDiff`
  - comments: `sendComment`, `reviewButton`, `commentForm`, `commentView`, `addComment`
  - previous rounds: `outcomeBadge`, `evidenceLine`, `previousCard`, `previousComments`
  - diff: `reviewRow`, `renderReviewDiff`
- `src/suite/page.html`, review code: `reviewShown`, `rv`, `reviewErr`, `reviewCall`, `buildReview`, `updateReview`, and the `/api/suite` fields `reviewWaiting` and `reviewDecision`.
- `src/web/server.ts` L169–235 and `src/suite/server.ts` L143–203: the review endpoints (`/review…` vs `/api/review…`). They return the same shapes:
  - `GET /review` → `{round, blocking, diffBase, diffHead, files, comments, outcomes}`
  - `/review/diff?file=&round=` → `FileDiff`
  - comments: POST, PUT, DELETE, resolve, reopen `{followUp}`
  - decisions: apply `{force?}`, changes, drop

  Errors: 409 when not waiting, 400 with `{error}`.
- `TESTING.md` "Human review": the manual flow to check.

## Patterns to follow

**One module, two URL prefixes:**
```js
// @ts-check
/** @param {string} prefix "" for the run page, "/api" for the suite page */
export function reviewApi(prefix) {
  return {
    review: `${prefix}/review`,
    diff: (file, round) => `${prefix}/review/diff?file=${encodeURIComponent(file)}&round=${round}`,
    comments: `${prefix}/review/comments`,
    comment: (id) => `${prefix}/review/comments/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
    decide: (what) => `${prefix}/review/${what}`, // apply | changes | drop
  };
}
/** @returns {{ refresh(): Promise<void>, busy(): boolean }} busy = a form has unsaved text */
export function mountReview(tabEl, footerEl, { api, onDone }) {}
```
**Don't destroy typing.** Both pages re-render on every state change (SSE on the run page, a 1s `/api/suite` poll on the suite page). `mountReview` only re-renders when the round changes or after its own successful write, and never while `busy()` is true. The run page has this rule today in `syncReviewDiff`, so keep it.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `src/web/assets/review.js` and `src/web/assets/review.css`

- **IMPLEMENT**: move the run page's review functions into the module, nearly verbatim, parameterized by `api`. Use `mountDiffView` for the diff and the decision bar in `footerEl`. Pure helpers to export and test: `reviewApi`, `openCount(comments, round)`, and `decisionLabels({blocking, open})` → `{apply: "Apply" | "Apply anyway", changes: "Request changes (2)", changesDisabled}`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets` (a `review.test.ts` for the pure helpers)

### UPDATE `src/web/assets/panel.js`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `panel.addTab(name, {first})` / `panel.removeTab(name)`, so Review can appear while waiting. Add a sticky footer slot, `panel.footer()`, below the tab content.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets`

### UPDATE `src/web/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**: delete the review functions and the overlay card. When `s.review?.waiting`:
  - `panel.addTab("review", {first:true})`
  - `mountReview(panel.tab("review"), panel.footer(), { api: reviewApi("") })`
  - open the panel at `Math.max(innerWidth*0.6, 640)` unless the width was set by dragging in this session

  When review ends, remove the tab.
- **GOTCHA**: keep `id="request-changes"` on the Request changes button, and keep the `EventSource` literal in the page (a server test checks it).
- **VALIDATE**: build, then the TESTING.md "Human review" flow end to end with agent-browser: comment, Request changes, the round 2 pause with fixer notes, Resolve, Apply.

### UPDATE `src/suite/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**: delete `buildReview` / `showDiff` / `reviewCall`, and use `mountReview(..., { api: reviewApi("/api") })` driven by `reviewWaiting` from `/api/suite`. Keep the "open findings" block, which `mountReview` renders from `blocking`.
- **VALIDATE**: build, then `demo/suite/run.sh --human-review`: comment on a line, Request changes, wait, Apply (agent-browser).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] On both pages, a waiting review opens the right panel on a Review tab at ≥ 60vw
- [ ] The Review tab shows the round's diff in the new diff viewer, general, file and single-line comments, live-check, and previous-round cards with fixer note, verdict, Resolve and Reopen
- [ ] The decision bar is sticky; Request changes is disabled until a comment is open; Apply anyway asks for a confirm and sends `force`; Drop asks for a confirm
- [ ] The suite page now supports single-line comments, edit and delete, and reopen with a follow-up, exactly like the run page
- [ ] Typing in a comment form is never lost to a re-render
- [ ] The old `#review` / `#reviewdiff` / overlay review markup is gone
- [ ] `npm test` passes, and agent-browser screenshots of the Review tab on both pages are in the report

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/web src/suite
npm run build
```
